text: Teaching Objectives This program aims to develop the studentswith higher management theories and systematic tourism management professional knowledge. The students should have the humanistic qualities, art of leadership, innovative consciousness, social responsibilities, internationalization. Main Courses Tourism Economics, Tourism Marketing, Tourism Planning and Development, Principles of Hotel Management, Travel Agency Management Duration 4 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor of Tourism Management by BohaiUniversity. Future Career After graduation, students will be the applied and compound talents who engaged in managing, planning, serving and other work of various types of tourism related enterprises.
